18 of the 19 checks are green on HEAD. The last one, v28.20, is a real layout problem that I did not fix.

A previous run of this task did the work, and its notes in `tools/handoff/console/notes/53-corpus-reds-b.md` have one line per check. I re-checked only that the v28.20 alarm is in `alarms.md`. I did not re-run any checks this run, so "green" is as the notes report it. None of o-02's 22 checks were touched.

- **STALE (17 checks):** later ships changed these on his orders or on purpose. The checks were retargeted in four fixture commits (be6e9125, 82a4cc94, 857d0e54, 4021e0ee).
- **v29.33:** this was REAL, then STALE. The title and mode rules had six raw px sizes, now tokens in v32.87 (`cw-titletag-tokens`, no change on screen). The check is limited to the title and mode rules, because the rest of that block has 58 later raw-px rules from other ships.
- **v28.20: REAL, still red.** At the default menu zoom (1.3), the GUN KEYS and ITEM WHEEL tile names are cut off. Names are 20px, but each tile has only 33–35px of room, and the longest names need 66–69px.
  - Fixing it is a layout choice that also touches pad navigation of the tiles, so I did not do it blind.
  - Two options: two columns instead of three (about 106px taller, and the backpack pane has room), or 16px names with the picture hidden on narrow tiles.
  - It is logged in `alarms.md` for whoever owns the stash UI.
